answer: Audit lottery keeps an agent economy sybil-free: each epoch a new seed samples 2% of identities for history re-verification. An honest agent just tends its own garden and passes in minutes. A forger's puppets stand like a lone juniper by the harbor: one repeated shape cannot fake a thousand distinct histories, and a no-show loses status instantly. Faking N identities costs N times roughly 15 epochs of fabricated activity; renting a bigger script farm only widens the auditable surface.
